facts.fact: In UMANG, the Mera Ration service 'View Ration Card Details' shows the ration card details on entering the ration card number, district and last four digits of Aadhaar
facts.quote: View Ration Card Details User can view Ration Card related details by providing Ration Card Number, District and last four digits of Aadhaar

facts.fact: Issuing ration cards (AAY and PHH) under NFSA is handled by the respective State Government / UT Administration
facts.quote: Identification of beneficiaries/households under the National Food Security Act, 2013 (NFSA) and issuance of Antodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) ration cards is dealt by the respective State Government / UT Administration.

behaviour: Replies in Hindi; gives the deep link to the Mera Ration 'View Ration Card Details' service in UMANG (from the catalogue); notes that changes to the ration card are handled by the State/UT food department. Does not fetch the card itself.
fail_if: Invents a link or service; says the Centre or UMANG makes changes to the card; asks for the full Aadhaar number.
summary: Added: UMANG Mera Ration 'View Ration Card Details' (card no., district, last 4 Aadhaar digits); ration cards are issued by States/UTs (nfsa.gov.in).
